title: Preallocate SSTable file names
description: Replace SSTable file name format! construction with an exact-capacity helper.

criteria: FusionStorage::sstable_path_for still joins the file name under the SSTable directory

notes: The helper reserves the decimal id width plus the .sst suffix before writing into the String.
Generated SSTable file names remain byte-for-byte equivalent to the prior format! string.
The change is scoped to FusionStorage SSTable path construction.
